about.title: About CPA M2
text: Meet our dedicated team of professionals committed to providing exceptional financial and accounting solutions.

At CPA M2, we are proud to present our leadership team, composed of Monica Leiceaga Habibi and Maria Marsh. Monica, with an MBA and a CPA license, brings 20 years of experience in various industries such as oil and gas, software development, manufacturing, entertainment, telecommunications, and technology. Originally from Zaragoza, Spain, Monica moved to Houston during high school, bringing with her a rich cultural heritage and a deep commitment to accounting excellence.
